pool.text: Bloemfontein was officially founded as a fort by a British Army major.
Residential segregation began with the passing of a specific municipal ordinance.
A railway line was built connecting the city to Cape Town.
The famous author Tolkien was born in the city on this date.
The city was the site of a conference that failed to prevent war.
The British captured the city and built a concentration camp nearby.
The settlement officially became the Judicial capital of the Union.
The South African Native National Congress was founded in the city.
The retail department store Kloppers was established in the city.
Raubex Group Ltd was established and later listed on the stock exchange.
The first rose festival occurred after council members decided to host it.
An eastward expansion called Botshabelo was added to counter housing problems.
EconoFoods was established as one of the major local companies.
Child Welfare celebrated its landmark ninetieth birthday in the city.
The local rugby team won the domestic tournament against the Blue Bulls.
The urban area served as one of the host locations for a global tournament.
Mangaung was upgraded to become an autonomous metropolitan municipality with the city.

Bloemfontein's GDP growth stood in the lower half of the benchmark group.
